manifest.text:
[package]
name = "omk-g1-clipboard-review"
version = "0.0.0"
edition = "2024"
rust-version = "1.99"
publish = false

[workspace]
resolver = "3"

[lib]
crate-type = ["cdylib"]

[dependencies]
arboard = { version = "=3.7.0", default-features = false, features = ["image-data"] }
napi = { version = "=3.16.2", default-features = false, features = ["napi4", "dyn-symbols"] }
napi-derive = { version = "=3.7.1", default-features = false, features = ["strict"] }
png = { version = "=0.18.1", default-features = false, features = [] }

[build-dependencies]
napi-build = { version = "=2.6.0", default-features = false }

licenseReview.limitations: License-file discovery/hash inventory plus focused source/statement review, not a legal opinion or whole-source license audit. No third-party source or license corpus copied to production.

inventoryCorrection.reason: The original filename heuristic matched COPYING followed by a period, misclassifying src/copying.rs and src/tests/copying.rs. Both are Rust protocol implementation/test code, not license documents.

staticSourceReview.scope: All selected custom-build/proc-macro entrypoints inventoried and hashed; entrypoint text inspected (libc via focused process/environment excerpts), plus focused helper/loader/decoder paths. No whole-source or generated-code security audit.

findings.observation: napi-build is an executable build helper, not itself a custom-build target. Setup emits macOS dynamic_lookup and GNU Linux -z,nodelete; Windows MSVC avoids GNU import helper. napi enables napi-build/wasi-heap-sync transitively, but exact WASI target-gated code is outside these six targets.
findings.gate: Future native-host linker/load/teardown evidence; changing features or targets requires re-review.

findings.observation: Future scripts invoke rustc probes, write/delete OUT_DIR artifacts and can honor compiler wrappers/RUSTFLAGS; other selected scripts query compiler/target cfg. No script or probe executed in this review.
findings.gate: Build with no credentials/unnecessary network and a pinned, clean environment after authorization.

findings.observation: Three selected proc-macro crates. futures default features bring futures-macro despite no Tokio. napi-derive type-def/noop/compat-mode are not selected; its type-def file writes are gated off. NAPI_DEBUG_GENERATED_CODE can print expansion tokens.
findings.gate: Do not inherit debugging/type-definition environment or imply all compile-time code execution is removed.

findings.observation: Unix loads host-process symbols. Windows probes process/already-loaded libraries, then Library::new("node")/Library::new("libnode") fallback by bare name. setup panics on total failure.
findings.gate: Validate fail-closed optional loading, DLL search/host identity, symbol availability and library lifetime on each native Node/Bun host; no loader-safety approval from graph resolution.

findings.observation: X11 PNG and macOS TIFF reader.decode(), and Windows PNG/BMP DynamicImage::from_decoder(), allocate/decode before returned RGBA reaches addon validation. No OMK caller-supplied limit at those inspected arboard entry paths.
findings.gate: Bound input/decoding allocations separately from returned dimensions/RGBA/encoded PNG; preserve async ownership and avoid user clipboard access during tests.

Native-host graph, ABI, loader and synthetic owned-clipboard tests on all six native targets; WSL is Linux
